title: 奥瑞利安·索尔·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 蓝紫蛇形龙身盘出修长曲线，金色双角呼应星光般的鬃毛。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Aurelion Sol is an immense celestial dragon with a long serpentine blue-violet body, a proud dragon face, sweeping golden horns and head ornaments, a flowing cosmic mane, and small forelimbs. Preserve his nonhuman sinuous anatomy and long stellar tail, without human legs or clothing. His eyes are serene and authoritative, and the embedded stars remain decorative rather than projectiles or destructive effects.
art_direction.scene: A complete long celestial dragon in a loose elegant S-curve across bright paper, proud head and golden crown near the upper third, small forelimbs clearly attached, long tapering stellar tail, NO human legs. Vivid azure, clear periwinkle, turquoise and sunlit gold pencil. Keep a single continuous coherent body and all horns inside the square.
art_direction.palette: periwinkle, indigo, gold, blue light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
